title: pvHyperTreeGridGhostCellsGenerator
body:
## pvHyperTreeGridGhostCellsGenerator

Generates ghost hyper trees at the interfaces between MPI processes for a distributed hyper tree grid, containing only the interface nodes and leaves. It is needed only in parallel runs before filters that use neighbour (Von Neumann or Moore) super-cursors; a serial run has no process interfaces. For ordinary datasets use pvGhostCellsGenerator.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Schemaxis serial examples do not establish MPI behaviour. Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `HyperTreeGridGhostCellsGenerator`. Identity: `filters/HyperTreeGridGhostCellsGenerator`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specified the input to the ghost cell generator. Accepted data: hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

No authored options.

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvHyperTreeGridGhostCellsGenerator",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
